lines.trans: I have crazy stage fright tonight.
Breathe, the audience will love you.
My jokes about vegetables were terrible!
It was your very first stage.
Nobody laughed in the room.
You showed great courage.
It is entirely your fault, Gabriel!
Why do you accuse me of this failure?
You insisted on this show.
I just wanted to broaden your horizons.
I want to do this costume film!
All right, you won, Sandrine.
Do you promise to sign this contract?
I will call the producer for you tomorrow.

meanings.en: to accuse, to blame someone for a fault

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?

examples.text: Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

examples.text: La vie, c'est une grande blague pour toi?
examples.trans: Is life a big joke to you?

meanings.note: faire une blague = to tell or play a joke
before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

meanings.en: costume (for the stage or a period film)
meanings.note: un film en costume = a costume drama / period film

meanings.en: bon courage!: good luck!, hang in there!

meanings.note: dans une heure = in an hour

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.

meanings.en: from, starting from, as soon as

examples.trans: Call me back as soon as possible.

meanings.note: preposition: en vacances, en huit ans
pronoun before the verb: j'en ai assez, je n'en peux plus

examples.text: Je suis entièrement d'accord avec vous.

meanings.note: pour faire quoi? = to do what?
faire du vélo = to ride a bike, to cycle
c'est ma faute = it's my fault
élargir ses horizons = to broaden one's horizons

examples.trans: I wanted to broaden your horizons.
I just want to see Mathias.

meanings.note: before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà

examples.trans: He eats a lot of vegetables.

meanings.note: object pronoun before the verb: tu me donnes
with reflexive verbs: je me débrouille
ne ... pas: not; ne ... plus: not anymore; ne ... jamais: never
informal: être nul en maths = to be hopeless at maths
always feminine, even for a man

examples.text: Je suis là pour voir Mathias.
Tes premières vacances en huit ans!
examples.trans: Your first holiday in eight years!

meanings.note: goes before the noun: les premières vacances

examples.text: Il doit faire preuve de respect.

meanings.en: faire preuve de = to show, to demonstrate (a quality)

examples.text: Mais le public ne la connaît pas.
examples.trans: But the public doesn't know her.

meanings.note: le grand public = the general public
a large or shared room: salle de presse, salle de réunion
une scène d'amour = a love scene
rien n'est signé = nothing is signed

examples.text: Je ne peux pas venir ce soir.
Le spectacle est à huit heures.

meanings.note: a play, a concert, a show on stage

examples.text: Le livre est sur la table.
examples.trans: The book is on the table.

meanings.note: sur la table, sur la route
before the verb; t' before a vowel
informal, one owner; ton, ta, tes

examples.text: Ça ne va pas du tout.

meanings.note: oui à tout = yes to everything
plural tous (pronounced 'tous' with s): merci à tous
before a noun: tout le monde = everyone

examples.text: J'ai toujours le trac avant d'entrer en scène.
examples.trans: I always get stage fright before going on stage.

meanings.note: avoir le trac = to have stage fright (final c is pronounced)
singular and informal: friends, family, children, colleagues of the same age
+ noun: je veux un café; + infinitive: je veux partir

examples.text: Le film va être un échec.
examples.trans: The movie will be a flop.

meanings.note: élargir des horizons = to broaden horizons

examples.trans: I wanted to broaden your horizons.
